about: Real openinference-instrumentation-litellm spans (Python) from litellm.completion. LiteLLM builds its HTTP clients internally, so every httpx request in the recording process is answered by the script instead of passing client=, which the instrumentor would serialize into the request bag. No network, no API keys, no rius SDK. Only the LiteLLM instrumentor is enabled; with the openai instrumentor as well, each OpenAI call would also get a child ChatCompletion span.
record: python record.py <recording.json> <environment.json>, in a virtualenv holding exactly the pins below

scenarios.chat: OpenAI through LiteLLM: a system and a user message, temperature and max_tokens set.
scenarios.chat_stream: Streaming with stream_options.include_usage. The instrumentor records no first-token event.
scenarios.tool_call: A tool definition with tool_choice auto; the response is a tool call.
scenarios.tool_response: The follow-up: the assistant's tool call and the tool's result in the input, a text answer out.
scenarios.anthropic_chat: Anthropic through LiteLLM's own handler: usage with cache reads and writes.
scenarios.error: The provider answers 400 (model_not_found); LiteLLM raises it as its NotFoundError.
